sources_used.source: Bing Maps local business search (browser, one query per category)
BestProsInTown Piscataway directory (town hub + category pages)

Own business websites opened directly (cjdentalarts, pebdental, leonardyeedds, piscatawayfamilydental, piscatawayanimalclinic, ambroseanimalhospital, perspectivesnj, artoflivingpiscataway, nailsalonpiscataway, lysscoleynails, capellihairsalonllc)

categories_thin: Yoga/pilates: only Art of Living (yoga/meditation) looks independent; the other two studios at 1642 Stelton Rd (Club Pilates, HOTWORX) are franchises. No independent yoga studio surfaced in multiple map searches.
Day spas / med spas: only 3-4 independent entries (LUXE Wellness, Snatched Aesthetics, Forever Young, Cassatone). Hand & Stone is a franchise; no other independent day spa appeared.

Therapists/counseling: most Piscataway listings are solo telehealth LCSWs/LPCs on Psychology Today, plus chain clinics (LifeStance affiliate, Ellie Mental Health, Handspring). Only Perspectives Counseling Center is a group practice with a Piscataway office.
Optometry/eyewear: only In Focus Vision Center and one solo OD; no independent optical shop found.

Independent day spa/salon suites at 371 Hoes Ln Suite 200: several suites (KB Luxe, Defined Look, Cassatone, Kingdom Chiropractic, Perspectives) are known but the building likely hosts more independent beauty/wellness providers that no public directory lists suite-by-suite.
caveats: Google Maps returned only a 'limited view' of 4-8 results per query in this browser session, so Google was used as a cross-check, not as the census. Bing Maps caps at ~12 results per query ranked by proximity, so some very small storefront businesses may be missing.

Excluded as chains/franchises (verified present in Piscataway): Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa (1292 Centennial Ave), Ivy Rehab Physical Therapy (1630 Stelton Rd #209), 24 Hour Fitness (1327 Centennial Ave), HOTWORX (1642 Stelton Rd #401), Club Pilates (1642 Stelton Rd #416), Kessler Rehabilitation Center (220 Centennial Ave and 250 Old New Brunswick Rd), Hackensack Meridian Rehabilitation at Piscataway (1080 Stelton Rd), HMH Primary Care - Piscataway (1080 Stelton Rd), Saint Peter's Physician Associates (1636 Stelton Rd #301), NJBH/LifeStance (371 Hoes Ln Ste 106), Ellie Mental Health (242 Old New Brunswick Rd #145), Great Clips (4917 Stelton Rd, South Plainfield), plus the YMCA at the Piscataway Community Center (municipal/nonprofit facility).

Regional/small-chain practices were kept in the list with a 'flag for chain review' note (SportsCare, Trinity Rehab, AmeriCare, New U PT, Certified Dermatology, Satsori/Satori martial arts) rather than dropped, per the include-if-unsure rule.

Several suites share addresses (371 Hoes Ln Suite 200; 1630 Stelton Rd Ste 201; 1100 Centennial Ave Ste 101; 1621 Stelton Rd). Duplicate-looking entries are flagged in notes; the triage team should merge any that are the same practice.

Piscataway is a large, spread-out township with several retail nodes (Stelton Rd, Centennial Ave, Hoes Ln, S Washington Ave, Rutgers-adjacent). Coverage is best around Stelton Rd/Centennial Ave; the Rutgers/New Brunswick border edge may hide a few businesses addressed as New Brunswick.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API and Overpass mirrors timed out or were unreachable from this environment; OSM was not usable.
YellowPages, Superpages, Yelp, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, Cylex and Opendi all returned HTTP 403/Cloudflare blocks; Booksy timed out. These would have been the best bulk census sources.

Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce directory (mcrcc.org) was not browsed member-by-member; only the Piscataway township listing was visible in search results, so chamber-member businesses in group B may be missing.
NPI registry (CMS) API was reachable but not exhaustively queried; a full taxonomy-by-taxonomy sweep could surface additional solo medical/dental/behavioral practices.

Phone numbers are Unknown for several directory-only entries (Hey Beautiful, anupamaa, Mehndi, Millenium Nails, Dina's, Heights Haircutters, Brothers Barber, House of Blades II, Cassatone, Flow Acupuncture, Lissah.Nails, KB Luxe, Defined Look, Justin Schaefers OD) - directories did not publish them in what was accessible.
